Mira Chen: FYI Acclade returned their security questionnaire. A few answers are requested around non-prod data, embeddings retention, and customer-managed keys. Can we put together short, copy-paste responses for them?
Tomas V: Quick tech answers: shared dev/staging clusters never contain customer PHI. If they need a data-like environment we can: 1) provide sanitized sample datasets; or 2) provision an isolated dev namespace on Dedicated with access controls.
Priya Singh: Add the contractual note: if they want real customer data in non-prod we require SOC2 scope adjustment + BYOK and an updated DPA amendment.
Deborah (Acclade): Do you support customer KMS with Hosted? Wewant to avoid moving off Hosted if possible.
Alex R: Currently, CMK/BYOK is supported on Dedicated and Private only. Hosted encrypts with provider-managed keys.
Mira Chen: For embeddings, what's the default retention and are there opt-outs? Need a short line.
Alex R: Default hosted embeddings retention = 30 days for safety/monitoring. We can offer no-retention opt-out on request (hosted) and retention controls on Dedicated/Private. We also provide a configuration to disable storage of embeddings entirely for strict customers.
Deborah (Acclade): Do you automatically strip or pseudonymize PII before storing embeddings?
Tomas V: No automatic PII redaction. Customers should remove sensitive data prior to ingest. For Dedicated we can deploy a preprocessing pipeline (hashing/tokenization) as part of an onboarding engagement.
Priya Singh: Draft compliance-safe blurb: "Redwood processes customer content as provided. Customers are responsible for redaction prior to sending. For Dedicated/Private deployments we offer configuration to minimize retention, support BYOK, and deploy optional pseudonymization pipelines under contract."
Mira Chen: Perfect. Tomas, can you drop a 3-line tech bulletset I can paste into a reply?
Tomas V: Sure:
- Non-prod: no customer data on shared clusters; isolated dev namespaces available on Dedicated
- Keys: BYOK/KMS supported on Dedicated & Private; Hosted uses provider-managed keys only
- Embeddings: Hosted default retention 30d (opt-out available); Dedicated retention configurable; optional pseudonymization pipeline as a paid add-on
Mira Chen: Thanks. I'll send this and propose a short pilot for Dedicated if they insist on BYOK. Deborah, can we do a 30-min call tomorrow 10am PT to walk through?
Deborah (Acclade): Yes, 10am PT works. Uploading the filled questionnaire now.
upload-bot: file uploaded: "acclade_security_q_completed.xlsx" (https://files.redwood/acclade_security_q_completed.xlsx)
Mira Chen: Got it. I'll follow up with the summary + next steps after the call. :white_check_mark:
